description:
Our product aims to solve the current scenario where most of the web3 reward systems are fully centralized. Most of these questing protocols don't serve their purpose efficiently. Most of these are non customizable, custodial and have high deplatform risk. We built a modularized and decentralized questing platform where users can claim rewards by verfiying their quests on-chain. We solve the problem of flexibilty by reduce friction in the business side giving them the freedom to create their own custom quests.

**Links**
- [https://github.com/gabrielantonyxaviour/dailygm-ethindia23](https://github.com/gabrielantonyxaviour/dailygm-ethindia23)
how_its_made: We tried implementing a lot of cool things in our product in Anon Aadhar SDK and also theGraph protocol. We wanted to build something that has never been done before. And with that of course comes the hardest of challenges. We ran into several issues, learnt and grew through it. We struggled a lot with the SAFE but it in the end it was worth it.
